text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: GPU OOM during prefill on cluster gpu-prod-us-east-2 — containers restarting, pager triggered. severity: P1 :rotating_light:

marta: I'm on rotation, looking now. paging SRE.

raj: seeing repeated OOMs on model-serve-7 pods. Prefill memory spikes on long-window (>12k tokens) requests — many from a single customer batch job (LumenAI).

kevin: confirmed container restarts with CUDA OOM and a driver reset on node ip-10-4-23-7. sample log:
```
[2026-03-17T02:09:12Z] cuda: out of memory while allocating 2.1G
[2026-03-17T02:09:12Z] runtime: container restart (exit code 137)
```

marta: mitigation proposal: 1) shed low-priority prefill requests 2) route long-context requests to coldmodel fallback 3) aggressive kvcache eviction for hotpool. applying in that order.

raj: applying throttle: set route.rule.prefill_priority_threshold=50 and prefill_max_window_tokens=8192 for production. curl snippet to patch route: 
```
curl -X POST https://console/api/routes/patch -d '{"prefill_max_window":8192, "prefill_priority_threshold":50}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

kevin: feature-flag rollout done (canary -> 25% -> 100%). also scaled hotpool 8->12 to absorb short-term burst. :white_check_mark:

alejandra: infra taking node ownership. will start cordon+drain ip-10-4-23-7 once hotpool stabilizes.

sre-lead: customer impact?

cust-ops: LumenAI reported increased 5xxs and timeouts for batch inference starting ~01:55Z. CS has initial notification to the customer; they asked for ETA.

marta: immediate customer message draft: "We observed GPU OOMs caused by large prefill windows; we've routed long-context traffic to a fallback model and adjusted prefill limits to prevent further restarts. We're replacing the affected node and will follow up with a full RCA and remediation plan." please review.

raj: kicked off aggressive kvcache eviction on hotpool: `kubectl exec -it hotpool-manager -- /bin/sh -c "echo evict_all > /tmp/kvcache_cmd"`

kevin: after throttles + eviction + scale: container restart frequency down ~80%, OOM errors reduced to isolated cases. still seeing 1 node reset in ~15m windows. monitoring closely.

alejandra: starting cordon+drain now, creating replacement node. will hot-swap once new node ready, moving pods gradually.

marta: logging next steps: 1) infra will replace node (alejandra) 2) SRE to schedule postmortem + exp backport (raj) 3) Research to validate quantization/long-window profiles for this model (kevin) 4) Cust-ops to send update to LumenAI (cust-ops).

raj: creating incident ticket/pm: INC-2026-0423, assigning SRE & infra. leaving thread, switching to ticket updates.

alejandra: replacement node provisioned, pods shifting, no new OOMs in the last 3 minutes. continuing drain.

marta: thanks all — marking incident as mitigated and moving to monitoring. will publish customer update and RCA ETA. :memo:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. handoff to infra and SRE for follow-up.

cust-ops: please cc account manager on the customer email.

marta: noted, will cc AM and ops. closing live mitigation thread, follow-up ticket contains logs and timeline.
